question.text: The RBI-SEBI Standing Technical Committee on Exchange Traded Currency Derivatives was formed in:

explanation.text: The Logic: At a joint meeting on February 28, 2008, RBI and SEBI decided that the Standing Technical Committee on Exchange Traded Currency and Interest Rate Derivatives would be constituted, fixing February 2008 as the relevant formation date. The Trap: August 6, 2008 was when the Currency Futures (Reserve Bank) Directions, 2008 came into effect — it is not the date the Committee was formed. Note: The Committee subsequently submitted its report on currency futures on May 29, 2008.
